antithesis: The challenge is that adipocytes have different optimal absorption spectra than other cell types
synthesis: We can conclude that full spectrum protocol sweeping all 7 wavelengths with 10 attosecond pulses each is the most effective strategy validated by the 2025 paper showing NO modulated precisely
conclusion: I believe that exposing hepatocytes to 1064nm light at 282 THz could repair mitochondrial damage in Complex IV
